decision: Selected the place coordinates of the Google Maps address place for Rua Jose Blumer, 150, Chacaras Assay, Hortolandia, that ODATA's own SP02 facility page links, as the campus locator of DC SP02.

selected_properties.operator_address: Rua Jose Blumer, 150 - Chacaras Assay, Hortolandia - SP (CEP 13186-510 in the map label)

identity_bridge: ODATA Brazil locations page (version 2026-09-25) lists Data Center SP02 at the operator address above.

ODATA's archived DC SP02 facility page (Internet Archive, 16 September 2026) links its 'Acesse o mapa' control to the Google Maps place with feature 0x94c8b99f784b16c3:0xaa679424523050d6 and !3d-22.8995184 !4d-47.1952378.
The Google Maps place capture of 22 October 2026 echoes the same place coordinates in its payload.
